text:
Global Academy 8th-grade math MCA participation ranks 3rd for 2024-25
D. R. Roland
According to the Minnesota Department of Education, Global Academy eighth-grade students saw the third highest participation rate in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Data shows that out of 318 total students who took the test at Global Academy, 56 were in eighth grade.
The results indicate that 18% of eighth-grade participants were deemed proficient in mathematics based on test standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state assessments designed to track student progress on Minnesota’s academic standards and to satisfy federal and state legislative mandates. These tests include math, reading, and science, depending on a student's grade level. Most students are assessed via the MCA, but some who receive special education services and are eligible may take the Alt MCA.
Statewide MCA proficiency across Minnesota has decreased compared to pre-pandemic levels, as reported by the Minnesota’s Report Card. In mathematics, proficiency dropped by more than 7% from 2019, while reading scores declined by almost 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in mathematics |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 49 | 73% |
| 4th | 53 | 42% |
| 5th | 51 | 10% |
| 6th | 54 | 22% |
| 7th | 55 | 22% |
| 8th | 56 | 18% |
Information for this story comes from the Minnesota Department of Education. Source data is available here.
